slots.notes: Deepest fullscreen background world layer (WORLD_BG, .jpg). Fills the sticky 100vh stage behind everything; on scroll it scales from 1 to 1.18 and parallax-translates by rx*6/ry*6 px. Center-weighted full-bleed landscape reads best since it stays visible the entire scroll.

Mid-layer portal frame (PORTAL_BG, .png with transparency) the viewer zooms through. Scales from 1 to 7.5 with transform-origin 52% 38% for an immersive zoom-through, fades out after 65% scroll, parallax rx*7/ry*7 px. Needs a transparent center/aperture so the world layer shows through as it enlarges.

Left foreground curtain (CURTAIN_LEFT, .png with transparency). Starts 62% shifted offscreen-left, slides further to 150% on eased scroll while scaling 1 to 1.3, parallax rx*14/ry*14*0.3 px on a translateZ(0) GPU layer. Edge-feathered/alpha cutout drape framing the left side.

Right foreground curtain (CURTAIN_RIGHT, .png with transparency), the mirror of curtain-left. Same scroll slide-out, 1 to 1.3 scale, and parallax on a translateZ(0) GPU layer but mirrored to the right edge. Should be the horizontal mirror of the left curtain so the pair reads symmetrically.

Orbit of three hero reel cards (CARD_IMAGES) rendered in 158x158px rounded-28px tiles in the hero. Fixed display order is Card 3 / Card 1 / Card 2: CARD_IMAGES[0] and CARD_IMAGES[2] carry a glassmorphic play-button + 'View Reel' overlay, CARD_IMAGES[1] is the 'World Patrons' metric card. Square-ish crops since each is masked into a 1:1 tile under a bottom gradient + blur(6px) label.

Brand star mark centered in the nav, authored as an inline 28x28 viewBox SVG (clean star path M14 2l2.09 6.42H23l-5.45 ...). Replace with the brand glyph; supply transparent. Fill is hardcoded in the SVG markup (not a CSS var), so retinting means editing the path attributes.

Display/heading typeface (native 'Viaoda Libre', serif), loaded from Google Fonts. Drives the 'FALL INTO REVERIE' hero heading and the 'FORGE BEYOND THE REAL' CTA heading (clamp 38px-78px). Elegant high-contrast serif.

Body/UI typeface (native 'Imprima', sans-serif), loaded from Google Fonts and set as the default body font-family. Drives nav links, captions, card labels, subheading and CTA paragraph. Clean sleek sans.

mechanic: A 480vh sticky-100vh stage drives a scroll-linked rAF render loop that zooms a transparent portal frame from 1x to 7.5x (fading out past 65%) over a slowly scaling world backdrop while two mirrored alpha curtains slide offscreen to reveal it, all layers also parallax-tracking the lerp-smoothed cursor, as the Hero cross-fades out and the 'Forge Beyond' CTA fades in.
techDelivery: Single-component React + TypeScript spec using Tailwind CSS plus heavy inline styles; hand-rolled scroll + requestAnimationFrame parallax engine (easeInOut / lerp / clamp helpers, useIsMobile media-query hook, per-frame transform writes) with no external animation library; Viaoda Libre + Imprima loaded from Google Fonts; bobUp keyframe authored in global CSS.
reskinNotes: The reveal depends on a coordinated 4-asset set, not a single hero image: a transparent-aperture portal PNG plus left/right curtain PNGs that must be horizontal mirrors of each other and an opaque world backdrop, all framed so the portal's center reveals the world as it scales 7.5x. The nav star logo is an inline SVG with its fill baked into the path markup (not a CSS var). All copy is hardcoded in JSX -- the 'FALL INTO REVERIE' and 'FORGE BEYOND THE REAL' headings, both body paragraphs, the six nav labels (Worlds/Atelier/Immersions/Craft/Codex/Connect plus mobile Explore/Connect), the '32 World Patrons' / 'View Reel' / 'Descend' microcopy. The CARD_IMAGES array carries a hard ordering constraint (Card 3, Card 1, Card 2) with the middle slot reserved as a non-photo metric card, so brand images cannot be dropped in arbitrary order. Colors are inline hex/rgba per element (text flips #3b1a0a on mobile/tablet to #ffffff on desktop) rather than a :root token block, and layout uses fixed pixel coordinates (top 46%, left 60px, right 40px, 158px tiles, 28px radii) plus serif-metric-tuned clamp() heading sizes that will need retuning for substitute fonts.
